title: Pepperoni Pizza
subtitle: Friday hall pie — not delivery
description: Friday hall pie — not delivery. Sized for a full crew, with timing that still works when the kitchen gets interrupted.

steps.title: Proof dough for multiple pies
steps.instruction: Bloom yeast in warm water 5 minutes. Mix flour, salt, oil, and yeast water; knead 8–10 minutes until smooth. Rise 1–1½ hours until doubled. For eight hungry firefighters, plan three large pies or four medium — scale dough portions accordingly.

steps.title: Simmer pizza sauce
steps.instruction: Simmer crushed tomatoes with garlic and oregano 15 minutes until slightly thickened. Cool briefly — hot sauce melts dough and makes a soggy center.

steps.title: Heat oven and stone or steel
steps.instruction: Place pizza stone or steel in the oven; preheat to 500°F at least 45 minutes. Prep cheese and pepperoni while the oven saturates — surface temp matters more than air temp.

steps.title: Stretch, sauce, cheese, pepperoni
steps.instruction: Divide dough; stretch by hand to 12–14 inch rounds. Sauce lightly — wet centers sag. Layer mozzarella and pepperoni; leave a ½ inch rim. Work on parchment or a floured peel.

steps.title: Bake until blistered
steps.instruction: Bake each pie 10–14 minutes until cheese bubbles with brown spots and the underside sounds hollow. Rotate once for hot spots. Keep finished pies on racks, not stacked — steam kills crust.

steps.title: Rest, cut, and run the line
steps.instruction: Rest 2 minutes, cut into 8 slices per pie, and fan on sheet trays. Classic Pepperoni Pizza night — dough, tomato sauce, mozzarella, pepperoni. Keep a backup pie warming at 200°F.

proTips: Keep a backup tray warm in the oven for late calls — nothing worse than cold plates after a run.
Taste for salt at the end — hall palates run salty after long shifts.
tonightSpread: Fan pepperoni slices on sheet trays — keep a backup pie warming at 200°F uncovered.
Cut each pie into at least 8 slices for hall portions; label plain cheese backup if you make one.
leftovers: Cool leftovers in shallow containers within two hours — deep pots stay hot too long.
Label trays with date and reheat to 165°F minimum before second shift.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Friday hall pie — not delivery. A hall pick for regular dinner nights — one line, real portions, no drama at the stove.
